description: This Java source file defines the Converters class, which acts as a factory and repository for Converter instances, managing conversions between different object types within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: Converters
classes.description: A final class providing static methods for managing Converter instances, including registration, retrieval, and loading of converters, with internal classes for creating pass-through converters.

classes.name: Converters.PassThruConverterCreator
classes.description: Inner class implementing ConverterCreator to create pass-through converters when source and target types are compatible.

classes.name: Converters.PassThruConverter
classes.description: Inner class implementing Converter for cases where source and target types are the same, returning the source object directly.

methods.name: getConverter
methods.description: Retrieves a Converter instance for specified source and target classes, creating or finding an appropriate converter, or throwing ClassNotFoundException if none found.

methods.name: loadContainedConverters
methods.description: Loads all public classes implementing Converter within a specified container class.

methods.name: registerCreator
methods.description: Registers a ConverterCreator to be used when no suitable converter is found.

methods.name: registerConverter
methods.description: Registers a Converter instance for specific source and target classes.
